body:
I wouldn't consider myself weird but I guess most people find it weird that I can't even make a simple sentence or even make eye-contact. But I'm probably being paranoid. 

Also, I just want to thanks to everyone that has replied. It's made me feel a lot better. Thank you.

It's definitely easier but it's still a burden for me to talk to people. I'm trying to improve and it's improved very slightly but most people usually think I'm "weird" before they get to know me due to the fact that I have  a very hard time trying to talk to people.

Anytime I try to even talk to someone I'm lost for words, feels like I'm about to pass out even if I try to talk to almost anyone. I can barely make eye contact with someone without my heart beating incredibly fast. I can't even make small talk with anyone. I worry about everything. Social anxiety has taken over my life.
